title: First music heard: the Palm Garden roof garden and places he later played
summary: Recalls first hearing music at the Palm Garden on Rampart and names halls and restaurants where he later played.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Can you remember the very first music you ever heard? Which bands when you were a little boy as far back as you can remember?
I heard that at the Palm Garden. I wasn't a little boy when I was four years old. I was around in the 20s, something, in the 20s, I think.
On top of the building. Oh. It's there now where Joe Peck is, I think it is now. Yeah, where Joe Peck is. It's because he didn't ramp up that. No, Grab and Rampart.
Yeah, on the top floor. Who was the top floor?
Was it that the Pithian Temple or?

No, it wasn't the Pithian Temple. The roof garden up there. I remember the roof garden too. Not that place. Not that place. It was on over the, right on Grab and Rampart. Right on the upstairs. Up there. And on the Padilla Rampart, I played there at the Golden Slipper. We punched.
And played at the next place.
And played at the next place. We played at the Ruby Restaurant at Little Woods. And played at Lutton.
